### Summary

This appendix is the index that the physics chapters cite for a run-time switch: one row per variable, with the line
that reads it at the pin, its default, its effect and the chapters that use it. @sec-ch12 owns the treatment: the
parsing rules in @sec-ch12-environment, the launch variables in @sec-ch12-layout and the switch combinations in
@sec-ch12-matrix. Variables that only snapy's tests read are in @sec-ch12-test-environment and are not repeated here.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Index of every environment variable snapy reads or sets at the pin, for the chapters to cite.

**Data.** 20 variables in four groups: 5 numerics switches, 10 launch variables, 3 UCX defaults, 2 build variables.

**Placement.** Numerics switches: first call of their accessor. Launch: each layout construction.

**Activation.** Off by default: `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`, `SNAP_WB_REF4`, `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE`. On: the other two.

**Guarantee / limits.** Each switch is read once per process; nothing checks that ranks agree.

**Evidence.** The ctest arms of @tbl-appd-tests; full treatment in @sec-ch12-environment.
:::

### Derivation

None: the switches select schemes whose derivations are in the chapters listed in each row.

### Numerical method

Each numerics switch is decided once per process, in five steps fixed by its accessor:

1. *Read.* `get_env` returns the variable's value when it is set, the empty string included, and the accessor's
   default only when it is absent ({{< code src/layout/layout.hpp get_env >}}).
2. *Normalise.* The value is lower-cased; it is not trimmed, so `false ` with a trailing space is a value of its own.
3. *Decide.* The switch is off when the value is `0`, `false`, `off` or `no`. For `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`,
   `SNAP_WB_REF4`, `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE` and `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` an empty value is off as well;
   `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT` has no such test, so an empty value leaves it on. Every other value is on.
4. *Cache.* The result is kept in a function-local `static`, so the first call fixes it for every block of the
   process, and a later change of the environment has no effect.
5. *Imply.* `wb_ref4_enabled` returns its own result or `x1_centroid_exact_enabled()`, so `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`
   turns `SNAP_WB_REF4` on ({{< code src/hydro/wb_ref4.cpp wb_ref4_enabled >}}).

Unset, the defaults give three switches off (`SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`, `SNAP_WB_REF4`, `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE`)
and two on (`SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE`, `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT`). The corrected-PE switch acts only where
`radial_exact_work` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::radial_exact_work >}}) finds face gravity work on a
grid with an $x_1$ measure: Cartesian, spherical-polar or gnomonic-equiangle.

The launch variables are read each time layout options are constructed, and again for `BACKEND` and `DEVICE` when
they are read from YAML. The `BACKEND` default comes from `default_backend` ({{< code src/layout/layout.cpp default_backend >}}). The three
communication defaults are written, not read, by `set_default_env` ({{< code src/layout/process_group_ucx.cpp set_default_env >}}), only when the variable is
unset and only in a build with UCX; they are listed because they change the process environment that commux sees.

### Code

**How to set a switch.** The switches are environment variables of the process that runs snapy, set before it
starts; there is no YAML key for them. For example, the fourth-order reference with the corrected-PE work off, on
the Straka deck, in `build/bin` of a build at the pin ([Install and run](#sec-preface-install)):

```sh
SNAP_WB_REF4=1 SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT=0 ./straka.release straka_single.yaml
```

The deck has `nghost: 3`, which refusal 1 below needs. A run with several processes needs a common rendezvous
port, which `torchrun` sets from `--master-port`:
`torchrun --no-python --nproc-per-node=2 --master-port=29573 ./straka.release straka_proc2.yaml`.

**What is refused, and why.** Nothing in the parse refuses a value: an unrecognised value turns a switch on
(step 3 of the Numerical method above). Setup refuses three combinations:

1. *`SNAP_WB_REF4` (or `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`) with nonzero gravity and `nghost` < 3*: the resolution flag reads
   scan pressures three cells away, so both sides of an $x_1$ seam agree only with three ghost cells
   ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}).
2. *`SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE` with nonzero gravity and fewer than 3 $x_1$ cells per block*: the one-sided wall
   density spans three cells ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}).
3. *An unset `MASTER_PORT` with either world size above 1*: the processes could not meet on one port
   ({{< code src/layout/layout.cpp LayoutOptionsImpl::LayoutOptionsImpl >}}).

**The code, mapped to the five steps of the Numerical method above**
({{< code src/hydro/wb_ref4.cpp wb_ref4_enabled >}}):

```cpp
bool wb_ref4_enabled() {
  static const bool on = [] {                                    // step 4: once per process
    auto v = get_env("SNAP_WB_REF4", "0");                       // step 1: default "0" only if unset
    std::transform(v.begin(), v.end(), v.begin(),
                   [](unsigned char c) { return std::tolower(c); });   // step 2: lower-case, no trim
    return !(v.empty() || v == "0" || v == "false" || v == "off" || v == "no");  // step 3
  }();
  return on || x1_centroid_exact_enabled();                      // step 5: XC implies WB
}
```

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_x1_seam_split_x1_centroid`, `_x1_centroid_cuda`; `test_x1_seam_split_mp_x1_centroid`; `test_balance_column_x1_centroid`, `test_face_floor_x1_centroid` | with `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT=1`: the split column equals one block, and the reference checks hold (XC implies WB) | per test | the test sources |
| `test_x1_seam_split_wb_ref4`, `_wb_ref4_gravity_0`, `_wb_ref4_cuda`; `test_x1_seam_split_mp_wb_ref4`; `test_balance_column_wb_ref4`, `test_face_floor_wb_ref4` | with `SNAP_WB_REF4=1`: the switched reference at the seam and in the balance/floor checks; no `nghost` check without gravity | per test | the test sources |
| `test_x1_seam_split_x1_mass_covariance` | with `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE=1`: a block with fewer than 3 $x_1$ cells is refused | exact (throws) | a guard |
| `test_x1_seam_split_radial_exact`, `_radial_exact_off` (and `_cuda`); `test_x1_seam_split_mp_radial_exact`, `_radial_exact_off`; `test_implicit_face_work_operator_radial_exact`, `test_implicit_stratified_solid_radial_exact` | the corrected-PE work on (=1) and off (=0) | per test | the test sources |
| `test_forcing`, `test_gravity_work_fixer`, `test_horizontal_flux_covariance`, `test_flux_covariance_rows`, `test_implicit_face_work_operator`, `test_implicit_stratified_solid` | run with `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT=0`, because they check the plain face work | per test | the test sources |
| `test_flux_positivity_carry`, `test_flux_positivity`, `test_flux_positivity_cubedsphere_cov_off` (=0); `test_pref_local_seam_flux_covariance`, `test_flux_positivity_cubedsphere_flux_covariance`, `test_scalar_cov_x1_split` (=1) | `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` off for the unlimited base arms, on for the seam and panel arms | per test | the test sources |

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
A numerics switch that differs between ranks makes shared faces two-valued, and no code compares the ranks' values.
A numerics switch changed after the first call has no effect in that process.
:::

- `distribute/backend` in YAML passes the key check but is never read; only `BACKEND` selects the backend.
- `LOCAL_RANK` has two defaults: 0 in the C++ layout options, the rank modulo the GPU count in `init_dist`.
- An unset `NC_HOME` adds the literal path `None/lib` to the package build's library path.
- The table covers `src/`, `python/` and `setup.py` at the pin; environment variables read by kintera, pyharp,
  commux, PyTorch or UCX themselves are not listed.
